title: Deep Learning & Computer Vision
summary: Train deep networks, then teach them to see.

stages.title: Deep Learning Foundations
stages.passCriteria: You can train an image classifier in PyTorch and explain each step.

stages.title: Computer Vision
stages.passCriteria: You can explain how a CNN sees an image and why residual connections help.

stages.title: Transformers for Vision
stages.passCriteria: You can explain attention, and how ViT and CLIP apply it to images.

stages.title: Generative Models
stages.passCriteria: You can explain how a diffusion model turns noise into an image.
